svg.title: 'Trusted files,' says the parser that runs on every stranger's pull request
svg.desc: A YAML parser node inside a CI pipeline receives a pull-request front-matter file through a fork trigger; the node is drawn as a sealed box with a visible crack and a tap line feeding untrusted data into it, while the required-check gate stands open downstream. Trace Bloom generative banner for “'Trusted files,' says the parser that runs on every stranger's pull request”. A isometric lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1624748074.
